Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R.No.81 of 2023 registered with Kundal police station,
Sangli for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f), 504 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC'), the applicants are seeking relief of pre-arrest bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.').
2. Ordinarily considering the nature of allegations, this Court would not have entertained application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text:
The facts which are peculiar in the present case are as under:
i. Registration of First Information Report by father-in- law against the victim which resulted into her arrest and release on bail in the month of December 2022.
913-aba-2313-2023.doc ii.
The first alleged incident is of 9th January 2023 against the father-in-law.
iii. The second alleged incident is of 15 th January 2023 against the brother-in-law.
iv. The third alleged incident is of 4 th April 2023 against the cousin father-in-law.
v. The forth incident against cousin brother-in-law alleged to have occurred on 6th April 2023.
3. The report has been lodged on 14 July 2023.
4. At this stage, prima facie, it is inconceivable that the incident alleged against the person who was responsible for sending the victim in jail would not be reported for the period of six months.
The applicants have, therefore, made out a case for grant of interim relief.

Hence, following order:
a) In the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with C.R.No.81 of 2023 registered with Kundal police station, Sangli for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)
(n), 376(2)(f), 504 r/w 34 of IPC, they be released on interim bail on furnishing P.R.
bond of Rs.15,000/- each, along with one or two sureties in the like amount.

b) The applicants shall remain present before the concerned police station on 21st,
23rd and 25th August, 2023 between 11:00 am to 2:00 pm and thereafter, as and when called by the investigating officer.

c) The applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any 913-aba-2313-2023.doc inducement, threat or promise to any witness acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer.
d) The applicants shall not obstruct or hamper the police investigation and not to play mischief with the evidence collected or yet to be collected by the police.
e) The applicants shall, at the time of execution of the bond, furnish their addresses and mobile numbers to the investigating officer, and the Court concerned, and shall not change the residence till the final disposal of the case.
